tagline:
Our home planet.
A testbed for other worlds.
intro: Start on Earth. Prepare for what comes next. Connect mission requirements to terrestrial sites, and make the strengths and limits of every analog visible.
compareIntro: Earth can reproduce some terrain and processes. Gravity, atmosphere and radiation set clear limits.
placeholder: Placeholder data is shown. These are not real scientific findings.
planetMapNote: Planetary coordinate diagram; no Earth basemap is used.
targetDemo: Target measurements use placeholders. Fallbacks are explicitly flagged.
sensitivityIntro: Seeded Dirichlet sampling shows how often a site is selected under changing weights.
dataIntro: Every score should be traceable. Competition Resources and supplementary portals are listed below. Product versions and coverage need team review.
notUsed: Not used yet; retained as a data portal
methodIntro: A replaceable starting point. Every assumption in view.
footer: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 · Team prototype; not an official NASA tool
mapOffline: Online basemap unavailable; candidate points and coordinates remain visible.
invalidWeights: Custom weights must sum to more than zero.
rankNote: Gap ranks and manual orders follow the team brief and need source review.
seedNote: Seed 42 · 20 demo sites · No scientific discoveries claimed
scienceNote: Understand what an analog can test before deciding where to go.
sensitivityStale: Settings changed. Run sensitivity analysis again.
researchIntro: From the four planning PDFs to explicit evidence, limits and next steps.
observedIntro: Measured windows from public datasets, separate from the mission demo.
observedMissing: No observed pilot has been imported yet. See the ingestion guide.
terrainDistribution: Slope distributions at a common analysis scale
weatherIntro: January 2025, local solar time. These coarse-grid reanalysis values do not measure lunar conditions.
observedOnly: Observed products and data-derived models only
observedTargets: Choose a study location with imported evidence. Unmeasured locations remain unavailable; values from another target are never substituted.
partialEvidenceNotice: This score describes the available comparable features only. Missing features prevent a complete task or mission score and cannot be counted as covered.
coverageRequiresComplete: Complete test coverage requires every required data pair and an aggregate test score above the threshold. A single matching feature does not complete the test.
taskComparisons: Comparisons by test and evidence coverage
noObservedEvidence: No validated numeric measurement has been imported.
rawSamplesOnly: Actual samples and documented bin means are plotted. Irregular satellite overpasses use points, without inventing values between observations.
pairingIntro: All lunar and Martian tests are mapped to planetary and Earth products. Imported context is kept distinct from comparable evidence. Open a comparison to inspect actual numbers and provenance.
fullProvenance: Full product provenance and quality metadata
missing_observed_measurement: Observed measurement missing on one or both sides.
sampling_or_quantity_not_comparable: The measured quantity or its sampling support is not comparable.
earth_proxy_requires_review: Earth proxy calibration still needs review.
small_manual_candidate_population_not_gl: Normalization uses three manual Earth windows; this is not a global search.
incomplete_evidence_not_a_full_mission_r: Incomplete evidence: no full mission ranking or complete-task coverage is inferred.
target_data_unavailable_no_fallback: This target has no imported measurements; no other target or demo is used as a fallback.
coverageDistinction: Comparable Earth data contributes to the feature results below. Data gaps, feature matches and complete tests are reported separately.
coverageReason_covered: A candidate has all required comparable features and its complete test score reaches the threshold.
coverageReason_partial: One or more observed features meet the threshold; complete test coverage is not established.
coverageReason_insufficient_data: Some features can be compared, while missing or incompatible pairs prevent a complete assessment.
coverageReason_no_comparable_data: No score-eligible pair is available for this test yet; existing context can still be inspected.
coverageReason_below_threshold: All current candidates can be fully evaluated, but none reaches the selected similarity threshold.
noCompleteTaskNetwork: No complete-test network can be selected at this threshold. The available feature matches and their Earth sites are shown below.
availableFeatureNetwork: Earth sites for the available features
availableFeatureNetworkIntro: Choose the smallest site set covering the observed features that meet the threshold. This feature-level result does not certify an entire test.
noFeatureMeetsThreshold: Comparable data exists, but none of these features currently reaches the threshold.
noComparableFeaturePairs: There are no score-eligible feature pairs for this selection yet. See the data gaps above.
featureMarginal: Benefit of additional sites for observed features
featureMarginalIntro: Weighted coverage of individual qualifying features, with missing requirements retained in the denominator. This is not complete-task coverage.
